overall_notes: This paper primarily focuses on safety/security evaluation of LLM responses against jailbreak attacks rather than traditional NLG quality evaluation. The evaluation centers on whether models successfully resist harmful content generation rather than assessing fluency, coherence, etc. Human evaluation was limited to manual verification of failure cases using attack success criteria.
